Thanks Jasmine — reviewing now. A couple quick clarifications before we get to the attestation:

1) Pinned region: Confirmed we want us-east-1. We do NOT want any automatic cross-region replication for customer data unless explicitly enabled and contractually approved. Is that configurable per-tenant?

2) Backups/snapshots: Do regular volume snapshots, backups, or node-level images ever land outside us-east-1 (e.g., for vendor backup, monitoring, or CI pipelines)? We need explicit confirmation that backups remain in-region unless we opt in.

3) Wipe proof: We need the deletion workflow to provide a machine-readable evidence file (hashes of records purged + timestamp + operator id) that we can store offsite. Can Redwood supply that and sign it? Do you have a template?

4) Third-party monitoring: Can you confirm whether any third-party log collectors or telemetry pipelines ship telemetry to external SaaS endpoints outside the pinned region? We must be able to opt those off for the Acme tenancy.

Also please include any expected timeline for producing the signed attestation and sanitized evidence package. We are running this through our InfoSec review next week.

Hi Liam, Jasmine — looping in concise technical answers below. Happy to jump on a short call if useful.

1) Pinned region (us-east-1):
- Redwood Dedicated supports tenant-level location-lock. When we provision a Dedicated cluster for Acme we can set an enforcement policy that prevents scheduling or storage of customer payload outside the pinned region. This is an explicit cluster configuration (not the default for hosted accounts).

2) Backups / snapshots:
- By default, snapshot and backup jobs for a location-locked tenant remain in the same region and are stored on region-local object storage.
- Cross-region replication is an opt-in feature that requires an explicit configuration flag and contractual approval. If you do not opt in, no automatic cross-region copies are made.
- Temporary artifacts created for build/CI in our internal infra are NOT surfaced to customer buckets for location-locked tenants. We run separate build pipelines that do not touch customer storage.

3) Wipe proof and machine-readable evidence:
- We produce a sanitized evidence package that includes: node placement map, snapshot manifest (metadata, creation timestamps), and deletion audit file. The deletion audit file is a JSON-lines list of record identifiers (hashed), purge action, operator id, and RFC3339 timestamp. We can PGP-sign the file or provide an HMAC using a customer-shared key for verification.
- Example: {"purged_record_hash":"sha256:...", "operator":"redwood-sysops", "action":"PURGE", "ts":"2026-11-28T15:12:32Z"} (we will supply a template).

4) Third-party telemetry:
- Telemetry collectors that ship to external SaaS are disabled for location-locked tenants by default. Any necessary monitoring is routed to region-local telemetry sinks or pushed to customer-managed endpoints.

Timing and artifacts: we can provide a signed attestation and the sanitized evidence package within 3 business days after you confirm: pinned region = us-east-1, retention window (we suggest 90/180/365 options), and whether you want cross-region DR enabled. The attestation will be a signed PDF and the evidence bundle will be a separate archive with the machine-readable deletion audit.

I'll attach the internal playbook excerpt and the audit-template for your review.

Attachments referenced: redwood_location_lock_playbook_v2.pdf, acme_audit_template.jsonl (template)

-Kind regards,
